highlights.title: Quiet projects stop flagging you
highlights.line: Paused projects and agents out of usage no longer mark a project as an Issue, and every row in a project's needs-you list can be dismissed.

highlights.title: Less repeated text
highlights.line: Notices, setup and adding a computer drop lines that repeated what was already on screen.

highlights.title: A way back to this computer
highlights.line: In the Kosmos app, View, Back to This Computer (Command Shift H) returns the window to this computer after you open another.

highlights.title: Joining says why it waits
highlights.line: A computer joining your Kosmos+ account now says, after a minute with no code, that your other computer adds one at a time.

highlights.title: An agent marking a task built tells the others
highlights.line: When an agent marks a task built, Kosmos now tells the task's other agents and whoever holds the task above it.
